name: Garden furniture 5 pieces metal and textile - garden table and chairs
material: 2*1 teslin fabrics, steel frame w/t powder coated. w/t tempered glass table
description: Set of garden furniture in 5 parts - 4 chairs and 1 table. Garden furniture is made with a metal tubular structure in gray. The table has tempered glass and an opening for a garden umbrella. The seats and backs of the chairs are made of textile, which is a high quality material with PVC coating for maximum stability and strength. All elements of the garden set are resistant to adverse weather conditions and protected from UV rays.
